name: fxf_loc002_intro_curtain
doc: Stands in for saves/field_re/loc002_intro_curtain.state: from the new game's overworld pan (ow_intro_pan, the stand-in for start_scene.state) 1540 frames of nothing (the pan, loc 271's wake-up text), then A every 12 frames 65 times: loc 002 in the opening, Mom about to open the curtain (obj10's idle loop, ip 0761).
